description: This file defines structures and functions related to sharing content via deep linking into an application, specifically constructing URLs with message contents and handling payload data for sharing. It includes a data structure for payload, and functions for building URLs and messages with safety trimming and length limits.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL with message and other parameters to share content via a custom scheme.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Builds a string message from payload data and an optional instruction, applying formatting and length limiting.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a string, returning nil if the result is empty.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Truncates the string to a maximum character count if needed.
